about.title: About Me
about.description1: I'm Francisco Guadarrama, a Computer Systems Engineer with 5+ years of experience building web applications and modules from scratch. My experience spans APIs, system integrations, workflow automation, analytics, cloud environments, and AI-assisted data processing.
about.description2: I work across the backend (Laravel, Node.js, Python) and modern frontend (Angular, React, Vue). In my day-to-day work I use Specification-Driven Development (SDD), agentic AI workflows, and Claude Code to ship faster with higher quality.

project1.organizationName: Ministry of Finance and Public Credit (SHCP)
project1.summary: Climate-financing supply and demand for adaptation and mitigation projects in Mexico.

project2.summary: Identifying and quantifying climate actions for government reporting.
highlights: Processed large datasets and mathematical calculations to quantify climate actions.
Built complex form validation and data structuring.
Laravel backend, Vue.js frontend, MongoDB data layer, and a Docker environment.
